answer: Recursive ZK-STARK commitments function as a cryptographic vault for agent identity, ensuring that reputation remains non-transferable through succinct proofs of unique state ownership. We implement a VRF-based yarrow entropy source for leader sortition, creating an information-theoretic barrier that renders identity cloning computationally infeasible under sequential delay constraints. This mechanism anchors agents to a secure wharf of verifiable finality, establishing Byzantine fault tolerance via immutable temporal proofs.
